audit.why: packet.levelChart reads Volibear/Volibear/Volibear/Volibear/Skill/Locke/Skill and both full phases[].side and content win[] match it row for row. 50.44% over 573 games supports an even lane that starts bad and flips at 6.

The listed spikes match the kit: Volibear's early is Q (12s down to 10s) plus W on a 5s cooldown, and Locke's flip is level 6 into first item. Stormbringer's 160/135/110s cooldown makes 'one ult per fight' true. spikes[] has all 4 entries.
audit.corrected: Timings kept; spike prose corrected for mechanics.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (a) spikes[1].text says 'his ult shields and health' — Stormbringer grants bonus Health only; the shield in his kit is Sky Splitter (E), and only when he stands inside his own blast. (b) The grounding on Locke's R goes unmentioned even though Stormbringer is a dash: a Volibear inside Purgatory cannot leap out of it. That is the decisive interaction of the level 6 flip.
audit.why: Riot's R text lists bonus Health and a slow, no shield; the E text is where the shield lives. And Locke's R carries a grounding flag ('shuts off enemy dashes'), which turns the execute zone into a trap rather than just damage.
audit.corrected: Ult described as bonus health; grounding stated as what pins him in the zone after he commits. Sky Splitter added as the real shield and his 1200-range poke.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sky Splitter (E) appears nowhere on the page despite being a 1200-range slow that also shields him — the longest-range tool in the matchup and the reason his step-ups are safe.
audit.why: A Locke player kiting at 950 assumes he has to walk in; Sky Splitter reaches further than anything Locke has, on a flat 16s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Added to spikes[0].text as part of his early dominance.

edits.before: Volibear owns early levels: his Thundering Smash (Q) run-up stun and Frenzied Maul (W) heal let him bully your Q-nail range, and stepping in to W-burst him just eats his empowered auto and self-heal.
edits.after: Volibear owns early levels: Thundering Smash (Q) stuns off the run-up, Frenzied Maul (W) heals every 5s, and Sky Splitter (E) slows and shields him from 1200 range, so stepping in to W-burst just feeds his sustain.

edits.before: This is your window: Purgatory (R) executes him before his sustain runs away, and if you time it as he commits Stormbringer (R), you drop him under the growing threshold instead of letting his ult shields and health save him.
edits.after: This is your window: Purgatory (R) executes him before his sustain runs away. Time it as he commits Stormbringer (R) — the grounding pins him inside the zone once he lands, and the bonus health his ult grants only feeds the threshold.

edits.before: Dive with Stormbringer (R) to bypass your E escape
edits.after: Leap in with Stormbringer (R) before your zone lands

notes: Stormbringer grants bonus Health, not a shield — the shield is Sky Splitter (E) and only if he is standing in his own blast. Locke's R grounding denies Stormbringer, which is the mechanic behind the level 6 flip the chart already records; I stated it in a way that agrees with the existing 'bait his ult, then totem' advice in mid so the two do not contradict.
